title: solanecio angulatus
intro: Solanecio angulatus, commonly known as the "Tournesol" or "Giraffe flower", is a plant species native to tropical Africa, belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Solanecio angulatus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
